items.q: What personal information does eBuddha Digitech collect?
items.a: For students and enquiries: your name, mobile number, email, city, qualification, course of interest and payment details. For business clients: business details, website and account access needed for the work. The website also records technical data such as your IP address, browser and pages visited.

items.q: Do you collect information when I just browse the website?
items.a: Yes, some technical information such as your IP address, device, browser, pages visited and approximate location is collected automatically, for security, analytics and performance.

items.q: What do you collect when I submit an enquiry or demo form?
items.a: The details you type into the form, such as your name, phone, email and the course or service you are interested in. We use them to reply to you.

items.q: How do you use my information?
items.a: To answer enquiries, schedule demo classes, process admissions and payments, run your course or project, issue certificates, provide support and improve our website and services.

items.q: Do you sell my personal information?
items.a: No. We do not sell or rent your personal information.

items.q: Who do you share my information with?
items.a: Trusted providers who help us run the institute and website, such as hosting, IT, CRM, email, analytics, advertising and payment providers. We may also disclose information where the law requires it.

items.q: Do you use cookies and analytics?
items.a: Yes. Cookies and similar technologies keep the site working, remember preferences and measure traffic and campaigns. You can manage or disable cookies in your browser settings, though some features may be affected.

items.q: Can I ask you to correct or delete my data?
items.a: Yes. Subject to applicable law, you can ask for access, correction or deletion of your personal data. Contact us using the details on this page. We may ask for proof of identity first.

items.q: How do I stop promotional messages?
items.a: Ask us to stop, or use an unsubscribe option where available. We will still send essential messages about your course, payment or project.
Yes. Where we rely on your consent you can withdraw it. This does not affect processing done before, and some data may be kept where the law or accounting requires it.

items.q: How do you protect my information?
items.a: We use reasonable technical and organisational measures and limit access to people who need it. No online system can be guaranteed completely secure.

items.q: Do you store my card details?
items.a: Complete card or banking credentials are processed by the payment provider. We may receive transaction details such as the transaction ID, amount, date and status.

We run educational programs for different age groups. A minor's information is handled under applicable law and any required parental or guardian consent, and parents or guardians with concerns can contact us.

items.q: How can I contact you about privacy?
items.a: Email ebuddhadigitech@gmail.com or call +91 84619 58162, and mention "Privacy Request" in your message. The Contact Us section of this policy lists our address.
